root_idea.summary: A relation of likeness, correspondence, or conformity between one thing and another.
root_idea.development: From the basic idea of one thing being like or set as a model for another develop the senses of counterpart, comparison, parable, exemplary punishment, representation, and upright standing.

senses.definition: To assume or appear in a particular form or likeness.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction تَمَثَّلَ, the subject takes on a represented appearance; the attested passage concerns appearing in human form.

senses.definition: More exemplary, best, or closest to virtue.
senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally for what is most like the excellent or most conducive to goodness.

senses.definition: A likeness or descriptive comparison; the comparable condition, state, or case of something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for describing one thing through its resemblance or correspondence to another, including a comparable state or situation.

senses.definition: A parable or illustrative example: a saying, image, or presented case used to clarify another matter through resemblance.
senses.usage_conditions: Common in expressions introducing or presenting a comparison for reflection, instruction, or illustration.

senses.definition: An exemplary punishment or punitive affliction made a warning to deter others.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural refers to punishments that serve as deterrent examples for similar wrongdoing.

senses.definition: A like, counterpart, or likeness; something corresponding to another in a relevant respect.
senses.usage_conditions: The comparison may concern kind, quality, quantity, manner, or another aspect of correspondence; attached pronouns and plural forms identify the thing or people compared.

senses.definition: Like, as, or in the same manner as, in a comparative construction.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with prepositions, conjunctions, or attached pronouns to express similarity of action, state, treatment, or circumstance.

senses.definition: The most exemplary or excellent; closest to virtue.
senses.usage_conditions: Feminine counterpart of أَمْثَل, used adjectivally for a way or course regarded as exemplary.

senses.definition: A representation, image, or statue; a thing fashioned in the likeness of another.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences are the plural تَمَاثِيل, presented here under the singular citation form.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or thing standing before or in the presence of another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mutilate or castrate, especially an animal such as a sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional transitive construction referring to punitive or physical mutilation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To resemble or be like another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III construction with an object or counterpart of comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set something upright or set it up as a mark or target.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Derived from the sense of standing erect; includes setting up a butt or other object for aiming.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use or apply a verse as a proverb or in a proverbial way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a verse or saying that is applied to a subsequent situation by analogy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become nearly sound or healthy, or to approach recovery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, wound, or disease in the process of convalescence or improvement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become alike or resemble one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or mutual construction describing similarity between two or more things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow, obey, or comply with a command, order, or injunction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Commonly constructed with أَمْرٌ or another directive as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An equivalent return or requital, including retaliation by doing to someone what he did.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the retaliatory or compensatory application of equivalence, distinct from ordinary comparison.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Depicted or fashioned after the model of another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a represented object made in correspondence with an existing form or model.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A model, pattern, specimen, form, or standard by which something is made, proportioned, or measured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for an example of a class, word-pattern, or rule, and for a manner or fashion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bed; in the idiom بَنَاتُ المِثَال, women.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic and archaic usage, not a general meaning of the ordinary noun in all contexts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Books or written works, in a rare poetic usage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attested interpretation of a poetic expression; it is distinct from the Quranic sense of represented images or statues.

The no-precedent expression is covered by the model or pattern sense.

cautions: The مَثَل group is normalized to the singular citation form although its Quranic occurrences include inflected singular and plural forms and one adjectival tag.
مُثْلَة and تِمْثَال are presented as singular citation forms for Quranic plural form groups.
The rare classical interpretation of تَمَاثِيل as written books is kept separate from the Quranic representation/statue sense.
